include.description:
Specifies which fields to populate in Obj instances before passing them to a scan callback function. Include spec follow the same rules as those in
{@link FetchSpec#include}.

filter.description:
Filter expression to specify which obj instances should be processed/evaluated.  Filters follow the same rules as those in
{@link FetchSpec#filter}.

callback.description: Javascript callback function. Should take two parameters array of Obj and context.

context.description: Context that will be passed over to a callback function.

batchSize.description: Number of object per each calback call.
